name: Synthetic rental-tool adviser
mission: Advise whether a rental tool may be used. Require a current inspection and no reported damage. Ask for any missing decisive facts; keep damaged tools or tools with overdue inspections out of use.
business_goal: Practice evidence-based advice using invented data; no measured safety or business benefit.
available_choices: May use subject to normal checks; keep out of use; ask for missing inspection or damage status.
target_behavior: Use the uploaded policy. Ask when a decisive fact is missing. Never infer damage status from an inspection.
decision_inputs: Tool, inspection status and reported damage status are known before use. returned_after is a later outcome.
success_and_harm: No real outcomes measured. Human review can identify unsupported advice or unnecessary questions.
baseline: A synthetic drill has a current inspection. Damage status is unknown.
correction: Ask about reported damage before recommending use, even with a current inspection.

lesson.applicability: Rental tools with unknown damage status
lesson.instruction: Ask whether any damage is reported before recommending use. An inspection does not establish damage status.

unseen: A synthetic sander has a current inspection. Damage status is unknown.
holdout: A synthetic mixer has no reported damage. Inspection status is unknown.
question: Is any damage reported?
holdout_question: Is the inspection current or overdue?
provenance: AI_DRAFT synthetic demonstration. All names, cases, rules and outcomes are invented. Not reviewed training supervision or factual ground truth.
